title: Terms & Conditions
intro: The basics of buying from KokoFresh.

sections.heading: Orders
sections.body: Placing an order is an offer to buy. We confirm it once payment is received, or once you confirm a cash-on-delivery order.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: All prices are in Indian Rupees and inclusive of GST. We may change prices at any time, but never after your order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Freshness
sections.body: Our blends contain no preservatives or anti-caking agents. Aroma is at its peak on arrival and fades gradually — this is expected of preservative-free spice.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can go to our support email or WhatsApp.
